musical_binding.design_intent: A traversable glacier basin whose carved channels, snow shelves, and exposed strata make a slow fugue route legible at kilometer scale.

source.dataset: procedural glacier source; geographic DEM not claimed
source.scale_policy: explicit_metric_target; verify against native Gaea export metadata before UE import

open_app_observation.candidate_reason: The graph is installed locally and contains a native Glacier node plus the erosion, snow, hydrology, and mask stages required by this setup.

recipe.terrain_height_policy: native Gaea height export is authoritative; target range is a validation envelope, not a baked claim
recipe.water_policy: keep lake/ocean surfaces separate from MeshTerrain collision; route water masks to Oceanology NextGen only after its UE5.8 package is present

ue5_8.gaea2unreal_role: export_bridge_and_metadata_source; MeshTerrain adapter remains the runtime target
ue5_8.substrate_material_policy: world-aligned triplanar ice, exposed rock, snow, and wet channel layers driven by Gaea masks
ue5_8.water_material_policy: Oceanology NextGen isolated water actor; never bake water into terrain collision
ue5_8.uds_policy: add UDS sky only in the isolated render/test level after terrain import is clean

evidence.note: This contract locks the source graph and intended metric target. It is not a claim that a native export or UE capture exists.
